_why: Real desktop sessions exposed rejected documented key names, incomplete observations, unstable window ordinals and misleading execution errors. These cases pin the supported behavior independently of any other implementation.

inputState.pointerChordDelivery: same system stream for down and up

windowsInput._why: Extended and Unicode encodings may share scan values without identifying the same held key.
windowsInput.keypadEqual: native keypad mapping or explicit unsupported layout

appStateDiff._why: Repeated observations stay comparable without hiding first-look content.
appStateDiff.default: diff from the state the model was last shown

scrollTarget._why: Content without an accessible element still scrolls at an observed point.

paste._why: Large or formatted text must not depend on typing keystrokes, and the user's clipboard stays theirs.

audioRecording._why: System output capture must stay bounded, single-active and volume-neutral.
audioRecording.retrieval: stop returns an audio content block

screenshotImage._why: Every turn ships a fresh frame; lossy encoding keeps repeated payloads small while the encoded geometry must still match the declared coordinate mapping.
